title: Briefing for 2026-11-03
intro: Good morning. Here is your briefing for 2026-11-03: US markets, global news, and the Philippines, in five minutes.
us: Australia hikes rates to 18-year high to fight inflation. Euro zone economy slows to 0.4% growth in Q3 as crisis-hit France contracts. European Central Bank keeps key interest rate on hold at 2.5%. Third-quarter U.S. GDP increases a better-than-expected 3.4% as September inflation accelerates. The politics of President Lagarde's European Central Bank early exit — and who could replace her. Analysis: Kevin Warsh is keeping Wall Street guessing. It may be his most powerful tool.
global: US strikes Iran ahead of midterm elections. Supreme Court rejects Trump's request to stop California counting disputed votes. Russian bombing kills 26 people at Ukraine aid centre, Kyiv says. Plane may have broken apart ahead of deadly Florida jet crash, say investigators. Shop freezers in seven European countries hit by cyber-attack. Fighting returns to Kherson region after longest Ukraine war ceasefire.
philippines: US Supreme Court rejects Trump, lets California count all ballots. ICC holds 5th status conference on Rodrigo Duterte’s case | The wRap. ICC wraps up pre-trial hearings as Duterte’s November 30 case nears. LIVESTREAM: ICC’s 5th status conference on Rodrigo Duterte’s case.
outro: That's your briefing. Have a great day.
